EVERY cents pair was escalated to 1,200-2,000 dpi tight crops before this verdict: rows 2 (15), 8 (04), 9 (02), 12 (57), 13 (05), 14 (79), 15 (97) and 16 (27) rendered unambiguously, and the two cells whose raised superscripts remain glyph-ambiguous are row 4 J.C. THE ARITHMETIC DOES NOT CHOOSE BETWEEN THEM (two candidate cells absorb the same 0.02), so neither was altered: GOTCHAS' 'closure outranks glyph reading' resolves a UNIQUE ambiguous digit, and this one is not unique. Both rows carry needs_review=1. The whole side is published; the sum stated here is 6,361.07 and the document's is 6,361.05, and both figures are on the record. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 6,361.05 and is never summed as an increment; it equals Column A only because this is the cycle's first report.
